configuration.architecture: hard condition-group split, NO group cross-fitting

decision_rule: NO model selection in this run. The untouched test stays sealed until the comparison report is complete and reviewed.

metrics.M1_lofo: strict leave-one-family-out. For each held-out family f: fit PCA and covariance on TRAIN groups excluding f; set tau on CALIBRATION groups excluding f; score VALIDATION regions of trained families (negatives) and all f regions from train+validation (positives). Report AUROC, average precision, TPR at tau, FPR at tau.
metrics.M2_known_false_positive_rate: full model, no family held out. Fraction of expert-labelled VALIDATION regions with rho > 1.
metrics.M3_clean_control_retention: the 24 frozen Phase-4 Method-A controls scored under each model; report acceptance of the 8 clean controls and rejection of the perturbed ones.
metrics.M4_threshold_stability: 1000 bootstrap resamples of the calibration GROUPS; report tau 5-95%, its relative width, and the fraction of validation regions whose accept/reject decision flips.
metrics.M5_context_shift: the five center-set variants from the v2 failure analysis (frozen M3 centres, all non-gas centres, random species-matched, paired full natural component, cropped-with-natural-context) re-scored under each model; report rho ordering and stability.

split.assignment: deterministic sha256 rank of condition_group_id, per dominant family
